decisionForTheFix: The stale reader pin is real and is the first refusal, as the task describes. Two further refusals sit behind
it for these buildings (REGISTRY_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE and DOCUMENT_STAGE_UNAVAILABLE), because the readers do not
use the original-only authority that the canonical read and the package read already use for geometry-free
packages. The fix therefore has two parts: (1) the split the task asks for: retained document results are
located and authorized without current pins on reads and on snapshot capture, with freshness stated; (2)
register, dossier and ledger reads send originals pinned by a geometry-free package to the existing
original-only authority instead of the staged-document one.

publishedShape: One additive optional field documentResult {current, reasons} on consolidated report sources[] and on snapshot
manifest members[]. Reasons: case_advanced, reader_changed, policy_changed, source_superseded.
It is present only when a retained document result is no longer current, so the digest of a manifest whose
document results are all current is the same as before.
The ledger states the same as a note in its existing missing[] list: its published shape is hand-written in
apps/api, which this task does not own.

whatWasWrong: Tower 3 (6f95d04e) and Magnolia (e8777ffc) were recorded from geometry-free packages that cite retained
originals only. The canonical read already authorizes such originals by identity and hash. The register,
dossier, ledger and snapshot did not: they asked for an accepted document reading whose pins are all still
Register and dossier, 409 STALE_REVISION: the reader hash stored with each accepted reading no longer matches
the served code. Named by elimination; the stored hash cannot be read through any GET.
Ledger, 409 REGISTRY_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: the cited originals are needs_input or received PDFs, which the
ordinary recording status list refuses before any pin is compared.
Snapshot, 409 STALE_REVISION: capture closes over every source of the site. The failing source is the GMDA
boundary original a6b2fd14, which no tower record cites.
Behind these, Tower 3 originals 357b6258 and 5293cd72 never had an accepted reading at all.
The same refusal stops the identity sequence, the packet plan and the property card.
